summary: LENSAR Inc. filed an 8-K on May 29, 2026, announcing the appointment of Michael A. Rossi as Interim CFO, effective May 29, 2026, after the prior CFO's departure. Mr. Rossi, 52, has experience as CFO at Access Vascular, ConcertAI, and Harvard Bioscience. He will be provided by Monomoy Advisors LLC under a consulting agreement with a cash retainer of $375 per hour. The appointment addresses a sudden CFO vacancy. No other special-situation events are disclosed, as the concurrent annual meeting scheduling is routine. Risk-arb angle is not applicable; focus is on interim financial leadership.
